boundary: Deterministic synthetic sampling with paired Dart production-API execution for normal, boundary, and adversarial partitions plus an independent Node observation-IR oracle. Missing and malformed inputs are held before production execution. The separate IR mutation layer calibrates mutation sensitivity and false alarms. Results do not establish exhaustive production-domain coverage, scientific truth, clinical calibration, patient-level accuracy, benefit, safety, or medical advice.

relations.precondition: condition tree is a finite object and all required observation keys are present with string-list values
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing required keys or non-list path fields are held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: remove non-required paths then minimize to one differing path

relations.precondition: non-empty synthetic candidate identities and required status fields are present
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing candidate identity or non-string status is held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: minimize to two candidates and one distinguishing token

relations.precondition: finite synthetic authority scores and required provenance classifications are present
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing or non-finite scores are held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: move adjacent scores toward the smallest order-reversing delta

relations.precondition: finite dose equivalence and non-empty jurisdiction and rule identity lists are present
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing chain or non-list rule identities are held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: minimize chain to the required prefix and rules to one equivalent pair

relations.precondition: one finite synthetic registry row and required observation keys are present
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing count or non-string compiled identity is held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: remove optional fields then minimize to one required-field deletion

relations.precondition: synthetic fact values share a comparable entity, attribute, unit, and explicit scope
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing classification or malformed scope result is held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: remove unrelated facts then minimize to one conflicting pair and one alternate scope

relations.precondition: synthetic replay cases expose decision paths and paired deterministic and observed candidate sets
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing replay pair or malformed candidate list is held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: minimize to one blocked replay and the smallest candidate-set difference

relations.precondition: synthetic loopback cases expose candidate sets, consent, endpoint, availability, skip, and transport-call fields
relations.preconditionBoundary: missing confinement fields or malformed candidate lists are held before relation evaluation
relations.shrinkStrategy: minimize to one candidate addition or one forbidden transport call

falseRelationFixtures.expectation: must produce at least one false alarm on valid boundary permutations
must leave at least one reviewed mutation alive
must produce false alarms on every valid source case
